pages.text: Old plague hospitals stand in the plains, forests and taiga: crossed doors, a ward of beds whose occupants do not all stay down, and a dispensary worth looting.$(br2)Beneath, a stair leads to a sealed crypt. $(4)Break the seal$() only when you are ready: its keeper comes when you do.

pages.name: The Gravewarden
pages.text: Its cleaver catches everyone near its target; it leaps on those who hang back; it makes the dead rise all at once. A lit brazier in the crypt halves its strength.
